verified_facts.text: Rosewood Miramar Beach is in Montecito, California.
The accommodation is made up of beach houses, bungalows and suites facing the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach houses, bungalows and suites are a front-row seat to the Pacific Ocean

verified_facts.text: The Garden Bungalow Suites sit within landscaped gardens in the center of the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled within lush landscaping in the center of our estate, unwind to the sounds of chirping birds and scents of lush gardens.

verified_facts.text: Caruso's serves seasonal menus paired with fine wines and signature cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seasonal menus, crafted with fresh ingredients, paired with fine wines and signature cocktails.

verified_facts.text: The Manor Bar serves literary cocktails in a space with a collection of books and art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Literary cocktails, inspired stories and a lively space amid a collection of books and art.

verified_facts.text: AMA Sushi is led by California-born Chef Scott Yonamine, who has spent two decades honing his craft.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by California-born Chef Scott Yonamine, who has spent two decades honing his craft.

verified_facts.text: The Revere Room serves California dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Quintessential California dining in an elegant yet inviting atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Miramar Beach Bar is the hotel's beachfront restaurant, serving cocktails and bites.
verified_facts.excerpt: Refreshing cocktails and bites in a lively ambiance at our beachfront restaurant.

verified_facts.text: At FronteMare, the Caruso's team prepares food live along the coastline for guests gathered around a communal table.
verified_facts.excerpt: Prepared live along the coastline, the team at Caruso’s welcomes guests to gather around a communal table.

verified_facts.text: The Miramar Surf Club offers surfing alongside local surfers as a taste of Santa Barbara's surf culture.
verified_facts.excerpt: Catch the perfect wave alongside local legends for a taste of Santa Barbara’s surf culture.

verified_facts.text: Luxury brand shops, from CHANEL to Zegna, are on the property within steps of the accommodations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rosewood Miramar Beach offers luxury brands renowned for exceptional craftsmanship and style from CHANEL to Zegna, all within steps from accommodations.
